Name: Marry Morris' portraits by RukaBravo
Author: rukabravo
Description:
[size=3]I was commissioned by [b]Haven [/b]to make a portrait sheet for Marry Morris 's mod in my own art style. I've made all vanilla characters before, but this design of Morris is a bit different. Haven wanted this portrait sheet to be available for everyone so she gave me permission to share her commission on Nexus as a mod. Enjoy!
[url=https://rukabravo.carrd.co/]
[/url]
REQUIREMENTS
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]﻿
[/list]
HOW TO INSTALL
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Open the folder you downloaded. Click on whichever "install" file is referring to your Operational System (MacOS/Windows..). A black screen will open. Read the text: it will ask where you'd like to install it - you may type 1 then enter. It will then ask whether you want to install it or remove it - you may type 1 then enter. 
[*]Unpack the ZIP file of this mod. Inside that folder, copy the folder named "Marry Morris portraits by RukaBravo".
[*]Paste that folder into your Mods folder, somewhat at this path:
\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[*]Run the game using SMAPI (the pufferfish/chicken icon). Have fun!
[*]NOTE: I already put the Portraiture mod INSIDE my files. You don't need to download Portraiture and do all the shenanigans from Portraiture mod. To make it easier for players who are not familiar with modding. Thank you to Plotonymous for creating PORTRAITURE mod! If you know how to use Portraiture, you can open my files and simply copy the folder RukaBravo to your own Portraiture mod file.
[/list]
My SV vanilla portrait mod:
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16904]RukaBravo's portrait mod[/url]﻿[/b]
